title: markermd grading template
description: A markermd grading template: the questions and validation rules used to grade student assignments. The assignment document itself is referenced by source.path and re-parsed on load.

format_version.description: Template format version, quoted (e.g. "3.0"; "3.1" when a question has scope: document; "3.2" when the template lists files). Versions before 3.0 must be recreated, and one newer than the installed markermd understands is rejected.

source.description: Reference to the assignment document the template was built from.

path.description: Path to the assignment .qmd/.Rmd, absolute or relative to the project root (the directory holding .markermd/), as template_export() writes it. Its basename is how each student repository's document is matched. read_template_yaml() resolves a relative path against the template file's directory and then the working directory, so pass assignment= when reading a file kept elsewhere.

files.description: The assignment's files besides its Quarto document, as paths relative to the repository root, that questions can target with file. Added in format 3.2.

file_path.description: A path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes, that stays inside the repository.

id.description: Unique question identifier. The id is what carries a question's rubric, scoring and marks across a rename: storing a template whose question keeps its id under a new name moves its grading to that name. Keep the stored ids when editing or regenerating a template, and give a new question an id above the largest one stored.

name.description: Unique question display name (compared after trimming surrounding spaces). The rubric and marks files name questions by it.

scope.description: What the question covers: "sections" (the default) targets the headings/divs in node_ids; "document" covers the whole document (the YAML header, render settings, and other issues that belong to no single question) and must not have node_ids. Its filters and rules, if any, evaluate against the whole document. Added in format 3.1.

file.description: The file this question covers; it must be one of the paths listed in the template's top-level files. Omitted for the Quarto document. A question on a file covers the whole file: it has no node_ids, rules or filters and is not document-scope, and it fails validation when a repository lacks the file. Added in format 3.2.

node_ids.description: Pandoc heading/div ids of the document sections this question targets, taken verbatim from assignment_outline(). A sections-scope question needs at least one for its rules to run. An id a submission lacks fails every rule of the question there ("Selected section #id not found in this document").

filters.description: Filter groups narrowing the question's node set before rules evaluate. Conditions within a group are ANDed; groups are ORed.

points.description: Deprecated per-question points. Scoring moved into the rubric; accepted for backward compatibility with older templates and ignored on load.

pattern.description: A case-insensitive regular expression matched against each node's qmd source (for has name, the heading title or chunk label). A pattern that does not compile fails the rule.

type.description: q2r predicate this condition maps to: 'node type' becomes is(<pandoc class>); the others map onto has_class()/has_id()/has_text()/has_label()/has_option()/has_engine().

value.description: Node kind or array of kinds (combined as logical OR) for 'node type'; a Quarto cell option ('eval' or 'eval: false') for 'has option'; a cell engine name (e.g. 'r') for 'has engine'; class name, id, regex pattern, or glob pattern otherwise.

negate.description: When true the predicate is negated (logical NOT).
When true the whole group's predicate is negated (logical NOT around the ANDed conditions).
